findings.evidence: Adapted.lean:77 defines `IsAdapted` and 120/157/220 give `.mono`, `.of_iso`, `.pushforward_of_iso` as its canonical API; Mathlib supplies the needed instance `Functor.preservesPointwiseRightKanExtensionAtOfPreservesLimit` (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Functor/KanExtension/Preserves.lean:450) from `PreservesLimit`, so the general lemma is a direct consequence of `RightExtension.IsPointwiseRightKanExtension.postcompose` (ibid. 363).
findings.fix: Add public `TopCat.Presheaf.IsAdapted.postcompose (G) [PreservesLimits G] : F.IsAdapted B → (F ⋙ G).IsAdapted B` to TauCeti/Topology/Sheaves/Adapted.lean next to `IsAdapted.mono`/`.of_iso`/`.pushforward_of_iso`, and generalize `isSheaf_presentationLimitPresheaf_of_isSheaf_rational` to take `(G) [PreservesLimits G]` (current statement is `G = 𝟭`). `isSheaf_underlying_presentationLimitPresheaf_of_isStronglyNoetherian` then becomes an application of that lemma to `isAdapted_presentationLimitPresheaf`.
findings.issue: `hAdapted` (`IsAdapted (presentationLimitPresheaf P Aplus ⋙ G) (spaRationalOpens Aplus)`, built from `presentationLimitPresheafIsPointwiseRightKanExtension.postcompose G`) is general infrastructure hidden inside a proof: its content is `IsAdapted F B → PreservesLimits G → IsAdapted (F ⋙ G) B`, which mentions only `TopCat.Presheaf.IsAdapted` and an arbitrary functor. Consequently the public reduction `isSheaf_presentationLimitPresheaf_of_isSheaf_rational` (KanExtension.lean:216) exists only for the un-composed presheaf, and this PR re-derives the basis-to-all-opens step by calling `isSheaf_of_isAdapted_of_isSheaf_restrictedTopology` directly (line 102) rather than through it.

findings.evidence: Cover.lean:116-131 (public theorem statement mentions only `presentationLimitPresheaf`, `TopCommRingCat.isCompleteSeparated.ι`, `spaRationalOpens`) versus Cover.lean:136; StronglyNoetherian.lean:90-94 versus 97.
findings.fix: Make both plain `import`s, matching the proof-only dependencies already imported privately in Cover.lean:12-14 (`...Localization.OpenEmbedding`, `...RationalSubset.Refinement`).
findings.issue: `public import ...StructurePresheaf.Empty` re-exports Empty.lean through Cover.lean although `subsingleton_presentationLimit_bot` is used only inside a proof (line 136); no public statement in Cover.lean mentions anything from Empty.lean. Same for `public import ...KanExtension` in StronglyNoetherian.lean:9, whose only use (`presentationLimitPresheafIsPointwiseRightKanExtension`, line 97) is in a proof.

summary: The surface is minimal and free of compatibility artifacts, but the general "adaptedness survives post-composition with a limit-preserving functor" step is proved inline in the main theorem instead of being exposed in `Adapted.lean`/`KanExtension.lean`, leaving the public basis-to-all-opens reduction usable only for the ring-valued presheaf.
